note: Denmark, read on New to Denmark (nyidanmark.dk, the Danish Agency for International Recruitment and Integration's and the Immigration Service's site) on 2026-10-30. A performer offered a job in Denmark paying DKK 552,000 a year or more (2026 level) takes a residence and work permit under the Pay Limit Scheme: DKK 6,810, normally decided in 1 month and up to 3 when more information is needed (3 kept, the longest), granted for 4 years where the employment is for 4 years or more (4 kept; shorter for a shorter contract), extended on the extension of the employment; it is applied for from abroad or in Denmark, and it is tied to the job (a new job asks a new application). The page on special individual qualifications (artists and athletes) answered with no content, and the pages on EU/EEA and Nordic citizens' residence and on permanent residence weren't found at the addresses tried, so free movement and permanent residence aren't written, and nor are naturalisation's years.

sources.title: New to Denmark, The Pay Limit Scheme
sources.said: You have been offered a job in Denmark with a salary of DKK 552,000 or higher. Normal processing time 1 month If further information is needed, the processing time can be up to 3 months Processing fee DKK 6,810,- ... If you apply from abroad, you can be granted a residence permit valid for 1 month before you start working. ... If you apply in Denmark, your residence permit will be valid from the day you start working. ... If your employment is for a period of 4 years or more, you will normally be granted a permit valid for 4 years. ... If your employment contract is extended, you must apply for an extension of your residence and work permit.
